name: Glint the Silver-Sedan Cat
blurb: Glint, a sleek silver-grey shorthair with a glossy just-washed coat and copper eyes, sunbathes on the warm stones by the garden gate.

name: Lane the Road-Stripe Tabby Cat
blurb: Lane, an asphalt-grey tabby with cream stripes like fresh road markings and leaf-green eyes, trots the garden path like an open road.

name: Curbside the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Curbside, a neat black-and-white tuxedo cat with white paws and pale green eyes, waits by the garden gate to greet every new arrival.
